children: Elme Communities repaid in full and terminated its senior secured term loan with Goldman Sachs Bank USA on Sep 14, 2026, ahead of the scheduled Nov 2026 maturity. The company used proceeds from the sale of Riverside Apartments to eliminate the remaining approximately $198.6 million balance. Upon repayment, all mortgages and liens on the remaining properties were released. No termination fees were disclosed.
